contentBlocks.body: Use if statements when the program must choose between paths. Keep each condition readable and focused on one decision.
**Worked example.** The condition answers one yes/no question. At exactly 50 the comparison is true, so return exits immediately. At 49 the condition is false and execution reaches the second return.
Using > instead of >= excludes the boundary. Test below, at, and above a threshold.

**Try a small change.** Write the expected results for 49, 50, and 51 before changing the threshold.

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.

payload.text: An ____ statement lets JavaScript choose a path based on a condition.
